maddeler.e:
انفجرت (form VII)
# اِنْفَجَرْتُ (infajartu) /in.fa.d͡ʒar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْفَجَرَ (infajara)
# اِنْفَجَرْتَ (infajarta) /in.fa.d͡ʒar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْفَجَرَ (infajara)
# اِنْفَجَرْتِ (infajarti) /in.fa.d͡ʒar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْفَجَرَ (infajara)
# اِنْفَجَرَتْ (infajarat) /in.fa.d͡ʒa.rat/: thir
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
